segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Great to see the rollout numbers. What is the plan for the renewal term?

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: Usage grew 40 percent this year, and onboarding time fell from 6 weeks to 8 days, which the board noticed.

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: I will champion the renewal internally again and set up the committee review; the CFO signs after procurement.

segments.speaker: REP
segments.text: Then let's book the renewal session - would Friday suit?

segments.speaker: PROSPECT
segments.text: Friday works, looking forward to it. Budget-wise we expect the same band as last year.
